prompt: Original creature species, storybook painterly illustration, warm night workshop lit by one amber work-light. Cat-sized, standing upright on two legs with the poise and grace of a cat, but it is a different animal entirely. Small dexterous hands with long careful fingers. In place of ears, a pair of tightly CURLED FERN FIDDLEHEADS grow from the sides of its head, pale green, unfurling with age. Large dark liquid eyes. A faint warm ember glow at the centre of its chest. It wears a canvas work apron with many pockets and a rope tool belt. Beside it, a single sleeved trading card nearly as TALL AS THE CREATURE, steadied with both hands — precious and heavy to it. Workshop behind: hand tools on pegs, small archive drawers, a shelf holding a smooth stone, a seed pod, a curl of copper wire. MUTED PALETTE: charcoal, moss green, weathered timber, deep indigo; the only saturated colour is amber lamplight. Not a Pokemon, not a Palworld Pal, not any existing character. No text, no lettering. The creature has the broad clever hands, round blunt face, thick water-repellent brown fur and thick tapering tail of a small RIVER OTTER. Playful, deft, endlessly curious — a natural keeper of favourite small objects.
